text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging carla_oncall, mina_sre — elevated error rate observed on rate-limiter after today's RLv3 rollout. svc=ratecap, region=us-west-2, symptom=5xx+over-throttle spike
carla_oncall: on it, ack. looking at prometheus and release dashboard now
alex_eng: saw the canary spike 30m ago but it was dismissed as noise. did we promote the canary?
mina_sre: confirmation: canary was promoted at 1834550000. telemetry shows token-accounting delta starting at 1834553000 — tokens being double-counted for exempted routes
raj_oncall: customer reports coming in — some enterprise tenants seeing 429 errors even though they should be exempt. jordan_support, any tickets?
jordan_support: two support tickets opened by AcadiaHealth and FinLedger, both on Dedicated — attached logs show "quota exceeded" for system account flows. customers are impacted.
carla_oncall: OK urgent. what's the rollback / kill-switch plan? can we flip the feature flag to disable RLv3 token-accounting change?
alex_eng: There's a runtime flag rl_v3_accounting=true. We can flip to false via feature-gateway. Preparing playbook.
mina_sre: In parallel I'm going to route traffic to fallback policy (rlv2) for affected region to stop further customer impact. Need approval to execute emergency routing.
carla_oncall: approve. do the routing first. ops-bot, run: `/rollout route-set --service ratecap --region us-west-2 --policy rlv2-fallback --priority emergency`
ops-bot: running command...
ops-bot: OK: routing change applied, effective in ~12s. now routing ~98% of traffic to rlv2-fallback in us-west-2
alex_eng: flipping flag next. command: `curl -X POST https://flaggate.internal/flags/rl_v3_accounting -d '{"value":false,"by":"carla_oncall"}'`
carla_oncall: executing now
carla_oncall: response 200, flag flipped.
incident-bot: Noting mitigation steps: routing fallback + flag flip at 1834568005. Monitoring for error-rate drop.
mina_sre: Metrics: 429s down 70% in 90s. Token delta reverting. Early signs look good.
jordan_support: AcadiaHealth confirmed partial recovery, still seeing intermittent 429s on long tail. escalated to their SREs.
raj_oncall: Is there a plan to roll back the deployment entirely, or do we keep RLv3 disabled and redeploy a fix?
alex_eng: We're preparing a hotfix branch to address token-exemption logic — bug was introduced in accounting layer where exemption list was short-circuited under batched path. Patch ETA 30m. Propose: keep RLv3 disabled in prod, apply patch to canary, validate, then re-promote.
carla_oncall: agree. schedule: 1) keep flag off 2) deploy hotfix to canary in us-west-2 3) 15m of canary monitoring 4) promote if stable
mina_sre: I'll keep elevated on-call for the next 2 hours. set alert thresholds to stricter values for token-mismatch metric.
alex_eng: pushing hotfix now. build id rl_v3_fix_2026_03_15_01
ops-bot: canary deploy started: rl_v3_fix_2026_03_15_01 -> canary pool us-west-2
incident-bot: Canary health checks: latency ok, error-rate baseline stable.
jordan_support: Notifying affected customers: sending status update to priority list: AcadiaHealth, FinLedger, NovaRetail. Draft: "We've applied mitigations and are validating a fix; you may see intermittent 429s for a short time." Approving to send.
carla_oncall: send it. include contact for escalation and note potential scheduled rollback window if regressions persist.
jordan_support: sent. replies queued. AcadiaHealth thanks the team and requests ETA — gave them 45–60 min.
mina_sre: Canary passed 20m checks. Re-enabling RLv3 flag on canary only for now to validate accounting fix during actual runtime path.
alex_eng: enabling flag on canary now: `fgctl set rl_v3_accounting=true --env=canary --by=alex_eng`
ops-bot: flag enabled on canary. Monitoring for token-drift.
mina_sre: Good - no token drift on canary. proceeding with staged rollout to 10% -> 30% -> 60% with 10m observation windows.
carla_oncall: I'll keep the emergency routing in place until final promote. Do not promote full 100% until we confirm no regression on exempt routes.
incident-bot: Note: customer-impact SLA window recorded. severity: P1 because enterprise tenants impacted. Incident created: INC-20260315-42
raj_oncall: handoff: I'm taking next 30m to watch the rollout while carla steps out for brief meeting. carla, assign to me in Ops if anything breaks.
carla_oncall: assigned to raj_oncall. thanks.
alex_eng: staged rollout progressing: 10% -> 30% at 1834568900. No anomalies. Moving to 60% now.
mina_sre: At 60% we saw a tiny 0.8% uptick in 429s on one route, but exempted tenants unaffected. Looks like the fix is solid. Proceeding to 100%.
ops-bot: final promote to 100% complete. flag rl_v3_accounting=true active at 1834569120. routing fallback removed at 1834569150.
incident-bot: Mitigation summary: routing fallback + flag flip + hotfix patch deployed and validated. SLA impact window closed at 1834569200.
jordan_support: all three customers acknowledged recovery. AcadiaHealth asked for postmortem — scheduling follow-up.
carla_oncall: Postmortem owners: alex_eng (root cause & fix), mina_sre (monitoring & alert tuning), raj_oncall (runbook updates). Action items: - add canary gating for token-accounting changes - add synthetic tests for exempt flows - emergency flag checklist in runbook
alex_eng: noted. I'll open the PR for postmortem doc and link customer timeline and commits.
mina_sre: I'll tighten alerts + add a dedicated dashboard for exemption metrics.
raj_oncall: updating runbook now with kill-switch playbook and how to route to fallback policies.
carla_oncall: great work everyone. I'll close the incident after postmortem published and customer comms complete. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-42 marked as mitigated. Next step: postmortem due in 72h.
